keyPhrases.text: Best of all is the refreshed choreography
replaced Gillian Lynne's compilation of stock moves with variety and invention
angular, sudden, inexplicable moves of catliness
moves as if she loves being in her skin
unspools turns and leaps with soft-paw landings

reasoning: Strong praise for choreography and specific performers with vivid, appreciative descriptions. Only minor criticism about 'butt-waving.' The enthusiastic tone and detailed positive observations indicate solid 4/5 territory.
